Which statement describes the direction of an electric field at a point?
A
the direction of the force on a negative charge
B
the direction of the force on an N pole
C
the direction of the force on a positive charge
D
the direction of the force on an S pole

options.label: A
options.text: the direction of the force on a negative charge

options.label: B
options.text: the direction of the force on an N pole

options.label: C
options.text: the direction of the force on a positive charge

options.label: D
options.text: the direction of the force on an S pole
